name: Stevie Awards for Sales & Customer Service
categories: Customer Service Department categories|Customer Service & Contact Center Achievement categories|AI & Digital Transformation customer service categories|Employee Wellbeing Program in Customer Service
summary: Global programme recognising customer service, contact centre, business development and sales achievements.
who_can_apply: Open to organizations worldwide. Eligible achievements fall between 1 July 2024 and 3 February 2027.
timeline_note: Late fees apply after the primary deadline, even in categories with no entry fee.
fee: Early-bird: $295 per individual entry and $520 per organization, team or department entry. Some categories have no entry fee.
notes: From the 2027 edition, Customer Service Department of the Year winners are decided by judges' scores blended with public votes. The 2026 winners list is published on the programme site.

name: Asia-Pacific Stevie Awards
categories: Customer Service Awards|Event Awards|Human Resources Awards|Company/Organization Awards
summary: Business awards recognising innovation across the Asia-Pacific region, with 150+ categories.
who_can_apply: All organizations and individuals in the 29 Asia-Pacific markets, large and small, for-profit and non-profit.
past_winners: IntouchCX (India)|NoBroker Technologies Solutions (India)|CleverTap (India)|eClerx Services (India)|Tata Consultancy Services (India)|Cisco Systems India (India)
timeline_note: The 2026 cycle ran: early-bird 20 Nov 2025, final deadline 17 Dec 2025, late entries to 15 Jan 2026 (later extended to 30 Jan), winners announced 12 Feb, ceremony 17 Apr in Macau. Plan for a similar Nov to Jan window.
fee: Entry fees apply. See the fee schedule on the programme site.
notes: Indian winners listed are from the programme's announcement of the previous year's winners. Confirm 2027 dates once the entry kit is out.

name: GRI Awards India 2026: Flexible Workspace Project of the Year
categories: Flexible Workspace Project of the Year
summary: Celebrates innovation in flexible and coworking workspace solutions, covering design, community building and adaptable environments.
who_can_apply: Operators and developers of flexible workspace projects.
timeline_note: Nomination dates not captured yet. Check the GRI Institute category page.
notes: Project-led category, so it probably suits a specific showcase centre better than the whole territory. This is an initial assessment to confirm.

name: SOCAP-exclusive Stevie categories
categories: Best Use of Technology in Customer Service|Innovation in Customer Service|Customer Service Training or Coaching Program of the Year
summary: Three customer service categories inside the Stevie Awards for Sales & Customer Service, open only to SOCAP members.
past_winners: Boston Beer Company (Innovation in Customer Service)|CH Consulting Group (Best Use of Technology in Customer Service)|BenchmarkPortal (Customer Service Training or Coaching Program of the Year)
timeline_note: Follows the main Stevie Sales & Customer Service calendar.
fee: No entry fee for active members.
notes: Only relevant if WeWork India holds a SOCAP membership. Past winners shown are from the 2026 edition.
